note_ar: كل ملف هنا بيتنزّل بس لو بصمته sha256 مثبّتة. أي قيمة مكتوب فيها TO-PIN لسه محتاجة تثبيت من المصدر الرسمي قبل أول إصدار — والبرنامج بيرفض ينزّلها لحد ما تتثبّت.
note_en: A file is downloaded only when its sha256 is pinned. Every value marked TO-PIN must be pinned from the official source before the first release; the app refuses to download it until then.

libreoffice_msi.how_to_pin: Pick the current stable version on https://www.libreoffice.org/download/download-libreoffice/ ; replace TO-PIN in version/url; take sha256 from the official '<file>.mirrorlist' page or compute it after download; set size in bytes. CI job 'libreoffice-standard-user' prints the computed sha256 when run with allow_unpinned.

webview2_bootstrapper.note_en: The evergreen bootstrapper changes with every Microsoft release, so it is verified by its Authenticode signature (signer Microsoft Corporation) instead of a pinned sha256.

font_vault.licence: OFL-1.1 / Apache-2.0 (per-family licence file shipped next to the fonts)
font_vault.pinned_by: every font file and licence file is pinned by sha256 in catalog/fonts/catalog.json (google/fonts at the pinned commit); only families the licence ledger allows to ship are included

shape_packs.label_ar: حزم الأشكال (5 مجموعات أيقونات مجانية للطباعة)
shape_packs.label_en: shape packs (5 print-safe free icon sets)
shape_packs.licence: per set: Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY-4.0 (credits page) — see catalog/shapes/packs.json
shape_packs.pinned_by: each @iconify-json npm tarball is pinned by sha256 (and npm sha512 integrity) in catalog/shapes/packs.json
